expression: (() => { const e=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(e=>e.getAttribute('aria-label')==='Add Board or Table view'); e.focus(); const s=getComputedStyle(e); return {name:e.getAttribute('aria-label'),focusVisible:e.matches(':focus-visible'),outline:s.outline,boxShadow:s.boxShadow,rect:(()=>{const r=e.getBoundingClientRect();return {x:r.x,y:r.y,w:r.width,h:r.height}})()}; })()
